---
title: "screen_time_v1"
---
```{r}
screen_time <- read.csv(file.choose())
View(screen_time)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
screen_time$plot_date <- as.Date(
  screen_time$date,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(screen_time,
       aes(x = plot_date, y = minutes, fill = app)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",
    date_labels = "%m/%d"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "My Screen Time Across Five Apps",
    subtitle = "October 12–25, 2026",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily usage (minutes)",
    fill = "App",
    caption = "Jiwei | Source: Apple Screen Time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "screen_time_v1.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
